submitted.rationale: XRD shows a Pb-rich phase (main peak at Q≈2.04) that dominates at high Pb, and a pyrochlore-like Pb2Sb2O7 phase (peaks at Q≈1.88, 2.37, 3.56) that takes over as Sb increases. The illumination is 2.1 eV, below the pyrochlore's expected gap. So EQE should favour the Pb-rich, lower-gap phase. The measurements fit this: index 1 gave 0.0074%, index 8 gave 0.0067% and index 18 gave 0.0009%, falling as Sb increases.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.0067%, lower than index 1. It is a mixed-phase film with more pyrochlore.
Measured EQE 0.0009%. It is mostly pyrochlore, which likely absorbs little at 2.1 eV.
XRD at index 24 shows the pyrochlore phase dominating, and EQE fell steadily with more Sb.
